corrections.current: Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency (formerly Dept. of Natural Resources)
corrections.why: The survey says the Department of Natural Resources is now called SERM. The Herald report names SPSA as the operator of the 2026 detection towers. No source found links SPSA to the Department, so the 'formerly' clause is unsupported.
The 2013 sources describe a province-wide plan to end observers at 42 towers. None names Salt Creek, so 'unstaffed' is not confirmed for this site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The survey gives coordinates and no height, build year or status. The only dated line is an unlabelled 1968 in the notes field, kept as 'other' and not used as a build date; it may be a stray entry. The brief's agency and staffing lines are province-wide, not specific to this site. Observer names are not used (same licence note as Round Hill). The story is short because the sources are.
